description: This file defines the 'CategoryWithNotesCount' class, a data entity used in the Android client for Nextcloud Notes, representing a category with an associated count of notes, including constructors, getters, setters, and overridden equals and hashCode methods.

classes.name: CategoryWithNotesCount
classes.description: A data class representing a category with the total number of notes, including account ID, category name, and total notes count.

methods.name: CategoryWithNotesCount
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all fields, ignored by Room.

methods.name: getTotalNotes
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes in the category.

methods.name: setTotalNotes
methods.description: Sets the total number of notes in the category.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the category.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID associated with the category.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare CategoryWithNotesCount instances based on accountId, category, and totalNotes.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on accountId, category, and totalNotes.
